title: Latency pocket triage — morning scratchpad
content:
Morning pocket triage (quick brain dump)
Owner: Maya Patel — short blocks today, focus on KV/cache latency spikes and small-batch regressions.

---

Top-of-mind problems
- 95th pct token latency regressed ~12% on canary after kernel refactor (PR #492). Logs show short tail spikes when kv-cache hits + context switching.
- Regression appears more obvious on seq=1024 workloads + batch sizes 1..4. Less visible on batch=8.
- Eviction pressure observed on model-host-08 around 09:12 UTC — mem churn correlated.

Quick repro steps (what I ran this morning)
- local bench (w/ small model): ./bench --model redwood/gpt-small --seq 1024 --batch 1 --iter 200 --tracing=short
- repro observed: p95 ~ 185ms -> 210ms after PR492 merged locally
- flamegraph: user-time spike in kernel/kv_cache.cc::apply_prefetch

Immediate hypotheses
1) Prefetch path introduced contention with background GC thread when cache eviction is active.
2) New locking in kernel refactor serializes hot-path on single core in some scheduling windows.
3) CPU affinity lost for inference threads when we spawn async metrics writers (rare, but seen).

Quick actionable TODOs (priority order)
- [ ] Roll back / revert PR492 on canary to confirm delta (quick test) — TODO: ask SRE to schedule brief canary revert (ticket SRV-3172).
- [ ] Add micro-benchmark isolating apply_prefetch (unit bench) to verify lock hold times. (me: write bench by EOD)
- [ ] Increase kv-cache threshold for eviction on canary hosts (+10%) for 4-6 hours to see tail behavior. (Ishaan to coordinate)
- [ ] Add lightweight histogram around lock wait times in apply_prefetch (10ms buckets).
- [ ] Run controlled A/B: seq 512 vs 1024, batch 1/2/4 with and without background GC.

Notes to self / observations
- When I attach strace to the slow process, there are bursts of futex waits ~15-25ms which line up with p95 spikes.
- On host with NUMA, observed cross-node memory prefetch — maybe need to pin kv-cache arenas to node-local memory.
- The regression isn't seen on gatling-02 (gpu v4 family) — something platform-specific. Check kernel compilation flags.

Commands / quick snippets for tests
- perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bench --model redwood/gpt-small --seq 1024 --batch 1 --iter 200
- sudo numactl --physcpubind=0-7 --membind=0 ./bench ...
- ./profiling-tool --hist-locks --symbolize apply_prefetch --out=locks.json

Measurements to collect (for the ticket)
- baseline p50/p95/p99 pre-PR and post-PR for seq {256,512,1024} and batch {1,2,4,8}
- lock-hold-time histogram for apply_prefetch and kv-evict path
- futex wait stacks from 5 slow cycles per host
- memory map / RSS + anon page churn during test run

Ideas / experiments (brainstorm)
- Replace exclusive lock with RW-lock: readers (cache hits) don't block, writers do. Worth microbenching.
- Try per-shard prefetch queues to reduce cross-thread contention.
- Move prefetch to bg thread pool with bounded queue — might increase latency variance but reduce tail.
- Add sampling flag to disable prefetch (~10% of requests) to compare tail impact in production.

People to ping
- Diego: can you push a rollback to canary and collect p95 delta? (SRV-3172)
- Ishaan: coordinate kv-cache threshold bump on canary hosts
- Noah (SRE): ask about scheduler differences between gatling-02 and model-host-08 (cpu isolation)

Open questions (quick)
- Is PR492 the only change touching apply_prefetch? (check PR diff + previous refactors)
- Did kernel compile flags change on canary images last week? (build metadata?)
- Could the metrics writer be blocking the inference thread due to shared fd?

End-of-sprint note (reminder):
- If we confirm lock contention, schedule a short spike window to test RW-lock patch (small canary, then ramp).
- Add checklist to SRV-3172 for rollback -> capture -> experiment -> revert or ship.

Random quick log (today)
- 09:03 quick standup: mention triage, gave Diego heads-up.
- 09:18 ran bench on local VM (results above).
- 09:42 opened SRV-3172 with initial measurements + flamegraph link.

"Notes to future me": keep this file simple, avoid long formal writeups here — this is tactical scratchpad. Move final decisions to Confluence page with experiment docs and graphs.

---

End of scratchpad (for now).
